title: 🔒 Mission — Password Validator
subtitle: Check a password against all five Morpheus security rules.
instructions: Two rules are already checked for you. Replace None on the has_lower and has_digit lines with the correct check, following the same pattern used for has_upper and has_special.
starterCode:
# PASSWORD VALIDATOR - Morpheus Security Systems
# Mission: complete the validation logic

password = input("Enter a password to check: ")

# Step 1: Check each rule
# Some checks are complete. Replace each None with the correct check.
is_long_enough = len(password) >= 12
has_upper = any(c.isupper() for c in password)
has_lower = None
has_digit = None
has_special = any(not c.isalnum() and not c.isspace() for c in password)

# Step 2: Count how many rules are passed
rules_passed = 0
if is_long_enough:
    rules_passed += 1
if has_upper:
    rules_passed += 1
if has_lower:
    rules_passed += 1
if has_digit:
    rules_passed += 1
if has_special:
    rules_passed += 1

# Step 3: Display the rule results
print()
print("=== MORPHEUS PASSWORD ASSESSMENT ===")
print(f"Password length: {len(password)} characters")
print()

print(f"Long enough (12+): {is_long_enough}")
print(f"Contains uppercase: {has_upper}")
print(f"Contains lowercase: {has_lower}")
print(f"Contains digit: {has_digit}")
print(f"Contains special character: {has_special}")

print()
print(f"Rules passed: {rules_passed} out of 5")

# Step 4: Display the strength rating
if rules_passed == 5:
    print("Strength: STRONG")
elif rules_passed == 4:
    print("Strength: MODERATE - almost there")
else:
    print("Strength: WEAK - choose a better password")
hints: Look at how has_upper and has_special are written — has_lower and has_digit follow exactly the same any(... for c in password) pattern.
has_lower needs c.islower() instead of c.isupper().
has_digit needs c.isdigit() instead of c.isupper().

codeChecks.contains: has_lower = any(c.islower() for c in password)
codeChecks.message: Fix has_lower using the any(...) pattern with c.islower().

codeChecks.contains: has_digit = any(c.isdigit() for c in password)
codeChecks.message: Fix has_digit using the any(...) pattern with c.isdigit().

successMessage: Your validator checks all five rules correctly. Test it with a short password and a long, varied one to see WEAK, MODERATE and STRONG all appear.
